page: Microsoft Azure D96nds_v6 is a network-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Dndv6 server family. Powered by an Intel processor with an x86_64 architecture, this instance features 96 dedicated virtual CPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration includes 5669 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, providing high-capacity local disk space suitable for applications requiring rapid read and write access. The instance is premium storage capable, though it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no onboard GPUs.

Given its high core count, balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, and substantial local NVMe storage, the D96nds_v6 is designed for network-intensive workloads, database hosting, and large-scale general-purpose applications. The hardware profile offers resource density for enterprise workloads that require dedicated compute resources and high-speed local storage without the overhead of specialized GPU hardware.
